EachImageAttemptTime - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Note: The parameter values below are only supported on platforms interfacing to the Honeywell scanner.
EAN_13_ADDONREQUIRED - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
For Zebra Scanner to see ScannerConstant.ParamKey.DECODE_UPC_EAN_JAN_SUPPLEMENTALS EAN-13 Supplementals are bar codes appended according to specific format conventions.
EAN_13_BOOKLAND_EAN - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
This property specifies Enable or disable Bookland EAN.
EAN_13_BOOKLAND_ISBN_FORMAT - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
select one of the following formats for Bookland data:
• *0 - Bookland ISBN-10 - The decoder reports Bookland data starting with 978 in traditional 10-digit format with the special Bookland check digit for backward-compatibility.
EAN_13_ENABLE - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
This property specifies whether EAN-13 decoding is enabled.
EAN_13_TRANSMIT_CHECK_DIGIT - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
The check digit is the last character of the symbol used to verify the integrity of the data.
EAN_8_ADDONREQUIRED - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
For Zebra Scanner to see ScannerConstant.ParamKey.DECODE_UPC_EAN_JAN_SUPPLEMENTALS EAN-8 Supplementals are bar codes appended according to specific format conventions.
EAN_8_CONVERT_TO_EAN13 - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Enable this parameter to add five leading zeros to decoded EAN-8 symbols to make them compatible in format to EAN-13 symbols.
EAN_8_ENABLE - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
This property specifies whether EAN-8 decoding is enabled.
EAN_8_TRANSMIT_CHECK_DIGIT - Static variable in interface com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
The check digit is the last character of the symbol used to verify the integrity of the data.
